integrity: The full integer-lattice proof is given in RESULT.md; the finite checker corroborates cases with 4 through 7 indices but is not an infinite proof. Classical facet combinatorics, terminality, and smoothness obstructions are credited as prior work.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies the reduced singular support, its component geometry, generic transverse completions, and anticanonical degrees. It does not compute Jacobian nilpotents or all nongeneric intersection germs. Literature equivalences remain a residual priority risk.
title: Singular strata and anticanonical degrees of complete type-A root toric Fano varieties
